entries.description: No test spawns cli.mjs or verify.sh with cwd set to the real repo root.
The CI workflow runs npm test with no local config before any step writes that file.
verify needs clear-protected-label and still runs when that job is skipped.
On synchronize, a label older than the event timestamp fails and a later label passes.
pre_tool refuses label, review, and merge commands without a ship instruction.
gh pr view and gh pr checks stay allowed.
CODEOWNERS lists harness/** before every other harness rule.
codeowners-coverage fails when a broad glob comes after a specific glob it covers.
report-present fails a partial acceptance file and names the missing ids.
Deferred lines take ids out of scope, and removing one fails the check.
report-present is green on this tree, including the gate spec through A-83.
